features: The update sheet now resolves the download link in the background while you read the changelog, so tapping Download & Install connects straight to the download server instead of waiting on GitHub's slow redirect first
fixes: Fixed the updater sitting on "Connecting…" for seconds before installing — the slow part was GitHub generating the signed download link (~1s) plus a second connection to another host, all hidden behind one word with no retry. The sheet now shows honest phases ("Contacting GitHub…", "Redirecting to download server…", "Starting download…") and a stalled connection retries once instead of dying
